title: Learning to read and arrange; Earl Palmer
summary: He recalls early reading and arranging mistakes and his childhood acquaintance with drummer Earl Palmer, whom he urged to attend Grunewald.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
